business_problem: VELLOWS needed a secure AI platform that could standardize knowledge management and accelerate proposal writing, but strict privacy rules and disconnected expertise repositories kept consultants from safely using AI at scale.
solution_summary: VELLOWS uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: VELLOWS needed a secure AI platform that could standardize knowledge management and accelerate proposal writing, but strict privacy rules and disconnected expertise repositories kept consultants from safely using AI at scale. Gemini Enterprise provides the secure enterprise AI layer for proposal drafting, document analysis, and future digital services, serving as the serving layer. Gemini Notebook analyzes complex project documents and extracts technical answers during live work, serving as the serving layer. Agent Designer lets non-technical users build no-code personal agents for routine work such as drafting emails, serving as the serving layer. Agent Search enables natural-language retrieval across company files in SharePoint and Outlook, serving as the serving layer. Cloud Storage stores finalized project documents that feed the knowledge engine surfaced in Gemini Enterprise, serving as the storage layer.
